name: ScienceClaw
description: Typed workflow (canvas) orchestration, the scientific tool library and the versioned Skill/Operator program for verifiable self-evolving scientific agents.

pythonBin.label: Python executable
pythonBin.help: Interpreter with the scienceclaw package installed

home.label: State directory
home.help: Holds canvas sessions and the versioned program store

inputRoots.label: Allowed input roots
inputRoots.help: Task input files must live under one of these directories

llm.baseUrl.label: LLM endpoint
llm.baseUrl.help: OpenAI-compatible base URL used by llm nodes and skill patching

autoPromote.label: Promote validated changes automatically
autoPromote.help: Off by default: an admitted program change waits for the user to promote it with `scienceclaw live promote`

autoSetup.label: Install the tool library automatically
autoSetup.help: On by default: installs the Python packages, pretrained weights and upstream sources of every tool when the plugin first starts (about 20 GB for the full profile). Tasks wait for it; `python -m scienceclaw.cli setup` does the same by hand.

setupProfile.label: Tool installation profile
setupProfile.help: full installs every tool; light leaves out the assets larger than 1.5 GB
